verses.ar: أَمْثَالُ سُلَيْمَانَ: اَلِٱبْنُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ يَسُرُّ أَبَاهُ، وَٱلِٱبْنُ ٱلْجَاهِلُ حُزْنُ أُمِّهِ.
verses.kjv: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son [is] the heaviness of his mother.
verses.web: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

verses.ar: كُنُوزُ ٱلشَّرِّ لَا تَنْفَعُ، أَمَّا ٱلْبِرُّ فَيُنَجِّي مِنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ.
verses.kjv: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.
verses.web: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.

verses.ar: اَلرَّبُّ لَا يُجِيعُ نَفْسَ ٱلصِّدِّيقِ، وَلَكِنَّهُ يَدْفَعُ هَوَى ٱلْأَشْرَارِ.
verses.kjv: The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.
verses.web: Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.

verses.ar: اَلْعَامِلُ بِيَدٍ رَخْوَةٍ يَفْتَقِرُ، أَمَّا يَدُ ٱلْمُجْتَهِدِينَ فَتُغْنِي.
verses.kjv: He becometh poor that dealeth [with] a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.
verses.web: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.

verses.ar: مَنْ يَجْمَعُ فِي ٱلصَّيْفِ فَهُوَ ٱبْنٌ عَاقِلٌ، وَمَنْ يَنَامُ فِي ٱلْحَصَادِ فَهُوَ ٱبْنٌ مُخْزٍ.
verses.kjv: He that gathereth in summer [is] a wise son: [but] he that sleepeth in harvest [is] a son that causeth shame.
verses.web: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.

verses.ar: بَرَكَاتٌ عَلَى رَأْسِ ٱلصِّدِّيقِ، أَمَّا فَمُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ فَيَغْشَاهُ ظُلْمٌ.
verses.kjv: Blessings [are] upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
verses.web: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

verses.ar: ذِكْرُ ٱلصِّدِّيقِ لِلْبَرَكَةِ، وَٱسْمُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ يَنْخَرُ.
verses.kjv: The memory of the just [is] blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.
verses.web: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.

verses.ar: حَكِيمُ ٱلْقَلْبِ يَقْبَلُ ٱلْوَصَايَا، وَغَبِيُّ ٱلشَّفَتَيْنِ يُصْرَعُ.
verses.kjv: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.
verses.web: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.

verses.ar: مَنْ يَسْلُكُ بِٱلِٱسْتِقَامَةِ يَسْلُكُ بِٱلْأَمَانِ، وَمَنْ يُعَوِّجُ طُرُقَهُ يُعَرَّفُ.
verses.kjv: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
verses.web: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.

verses.ar: مَنْ يَغْمِزُ بِٱلْعَيْنِ يُسَبِّبُ حُزْنًا، وَٱلْغَبِيُّ ٱلشَّفَتَيْنِ يُصْرَعُ.
verses.kjv: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.
verses.web: One who winks with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.

verses.ar: فَمُ ٱلصِّدِّيقِ يَنْبُوعُ حَيَاةٍ، وَفَمُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ يَغْشَاهُ ظُلْمٌ.
verses.kjv: The mouth of a righteous [man is] a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
verses.web: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

verses.ar: اَلْبُغْضَةُ تُهَيِّجُ خُصُومَاتٍ، وَٱلْمَحَبَّةُ تَسْتُرُ كُلَّ ٱلذُّنُوبِ.
verses.kjv: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
verses.web: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.

verses.ar: فِي شَفَتَيِ ٱلْعَاقِلِ تُوجَدُ حِكْمَةٌ، وَٱلْعَصَا لِظَهْرِ ٱلنَّاقِصِ ٱلْفَهْمِ.
verses.kjv: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod [is] for the back of him that is void of understanding.
verses.web: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.

verses.ar: اَلْحُكَمَاءُ يَذْخَرُونَ مَعْرِفَةً، أَمَّا فَمُ ٱلْغَبِيِّ فَهَلَاكٌ قَرِيبٌ.
verses.kjv: Wise [men] lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish [is] near destruction.
verses.web: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.

verses.ar: ثَرْوَةُ ٱلْغَنِيِّ مَدِينَتُهُ ٱلْحَصِينَةُ. هَلَاكُ ٱلْمَسَاكِينِ فَقْرُهُمْ.
verses.kjv: The rich man’s wealth [is] his strong city: the destruction of the poor [is] their poverty.
verses.web: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

verses.ar: عَمَلُ ٱلصِّدِّيقِ لِلْحَيَاةِ. رِبْحُ ٱلشِّرِّيرِ لِلْخَطِيَّةِ.
verses.kjv: The labour of the righteous [tendeth] to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.
verses.web: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.

verses.ar: حَافِظُ ٱلتَّعْلِيمِ هُوَ فِي طَرِيقِ ٱلْحَيَاةِ، وَرَافِضُ ٱلتَّأْدِيبِ ضَالٌّ.
verses.kjv: He [is in] the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.
verses.web: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.

verses.ar: مَنْ يُخْفِي ٱلْبُغْضَةَ فَشَفَتَاهُ كَاذِبَتَانِ، وَمُشِيعُ ٱلْمَذَمَّةِ هُوَ جَاهِلٌ.
verses.kjv: He that hideth hatred [with] lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, [is] a fool.
verses.web: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.

verses.ar: كَثْرَةُ ٱلْكَلَامِ لَا تَخْلُو مِنْ مَعْصِيَةٍ، أَمَّا ٱلضَّابِطُ شَفَتَيْهِ فَعَاقِلٌ.
verses.kjv: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips [is] wise.
verses.web: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.

verses.ar: لِسَانُ ٱلصِّدِّيقِ فِضَّةٌ مُخْتَارَةٌ. قَلْبُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ كَشَيْءٍ زَهِيدٍ.
verses.kjv: The tongue of the just [is as] choice silver: the heart of the wicked [is] little worth.
verses.web: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.

verses.ar: شَفَتَا ٱلصِّدِّيقِ تَهْدِيَانِ كَثِيرِينَ، أَمَّا ٱلْأَغْبِيَاءُ فَيَمُوتُونَ مِنْ نَقْصِ ٱلْفَهْمِ.
verses.kjv: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.
verses.web: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.

verses.ar: بَرَكَةُ ٱلرَّبِّ هِيَ تُغْنِي، وَلَا يَزِيدُ مَعَهَا تَعَبًا.
verses.kjv: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
verses.web: Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

verses.ar: فِعْلُ ٱلرَّذِيلَةِ عِنْدَ ٱلْجَاهِلِ كَٱلضِّحْكِ، أَمَّا ٱلْحِكْمَةُ فَلِذِي فَهْمٍ.
verses.kjv: [It is] as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.
verses.web: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.

verses.ar: خَوْفُ ٱلشِّرِّيرِ هُوَ يَأْتِيهِ، وَشَهْوَةُ ٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ تُمْنَحُ.
verses.kjv: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
verses.web: What the wicked fear will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.

verses.ar: كَعُبُورِ ٱلزَّوْبَعَةِ فَلَا يَكُونُ ٱلشِّرِّيرُ، أَمَّا ٱلصِّدِّيقُ فَأَسَاسٌ مُؤَبَّدٌ.
verses.kjv: As the whirlwind passeth, so [is] the wicked no [more:] but the righteous [is] an everlasting foundation.
verses.web: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.

verses.ar: كَٱلْخَلِّ لِلْأَسْنَانِ، وَكَالدُّخَانِ لِلْعَيْنَيْنِ، كَذَلِكَ ٱلْكَسْلَانُ لِلَّذِينَ أَرْسَلُوهُ.
verses.kjv: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so [is] the sluggard to them that send him.
verses.web: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.

verses.ar: مَخَافَةُ ٱلرَّبِّ تَزِيدُ ٱلْأَيَّامَ، أَمَّا سِنُو ٱلْأَشْرَارِ فَتُقْصَرُ.
verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
verses.web: The fear of Yahweh prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

verses.ar: مُنْتَظَرُ ٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ مُفَرِّحٌ، أَمَّا رَجَاءُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ فَيَبِيدُ.
verses.kjv: The hope of the righteous [shall be] gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
verses.web: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.

verses.ar: حِصْنٌ لِلِٱسْتِقَامَةِ طَرِيقُ ٱلرَّبِّ، وَٱلْهَلَاكُ لِفَاعِلِي ٱلْإِثْمِ.
verses.kjv: The way of the LORD [is] strength to the upright: but destruction [shall be] to the workers of iniquity.
verses.web: The way of Yahweh is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

verses.ar: اَلصِّدِّيقُ لَنْ يُزَحْزَحَ أَبَدًا، وَٱلْأَشْرَارُ لَنْ يَسْكُنُوا ٱلْأَرْضَ.
verses.kjv: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.
verses.web: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.

verses.ar: فَمُ ٱلصِّدِّيقِ يُنْبِتُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ، أَمَّا لِسَانُ ٱلْأَكَاذِيبِ فَيُقْطَعُ.
verses.kjv: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.
verses.web: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.

verses.ar: شَفَتَا ٱلصِّدِّيقِ تَعْرِفَانِ ٱلْمَرْضِيَّ، وَفَمُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ أَكَاذِيبُ.
verses.kjv: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked [speaketh] frowardness.
verses.web: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.
